zh-CN.name: CAD 制图
zh-CN.description: 通用二维 CAD 协作工作空间：接入 Python 或其他引擎生成的 DXF，持续修订、观察和展示同一份图纸。
features: 工作区与 Agent 复用同一 CAD 画布
选区提供参考，Agent 按版本连续修改并保留历史
按需转换 GeoJSON、检查与导出 PNG/PDF

en-US.name: CAD Drawing
en-US.description: A general-purpose 2D CAD workspace for Python-generated DXF and native edits, with shared views, observations and revisioned commits.
features: Shared CAD views from workspace and Agent
Reference selections and continuous revisioned Agent edits
On-demand GeoJSON conversion, validation and PNG/PDF export
